standard_commands.uxe:check: Run token/drift/static checks for UXE contract compliance.
standard_commands.uxe:component: Run component-safe JSX/TSX accessibility and semantics checks.
standard_commands.uxe:taste: Run deterministic taste-skill and AI-tell checks.
standard_commands.uxe:contract: Run style token consumption and style distinctness checks.
standard_commands.uxe:page-capability: Run declared page capability and component grammar fit checks.
standard_commands.uxe:capture: Capture screenshot and computed-style evidence for declared UXE surfaces.
standard_commands.uxe:visual: Capture screenshot or computed-style evidence for changed surfaces.
standard_commands.uxe:audit: Run UXE real-site or app audit plus accessibility checks.
